term: possible knowledge, actual knowledge and common truth-knower
definition: Step1 restricts possible knowledge to truths; step2 concerns actual knowers, and steps3–4 introduce one knower of every truth. Per-proposition witnesses, world-relative possibility and one common witness are distinct scopes.
note: No epistemic modal system, factivity, closure, proposition comprehension, agent existence or divine signature is defined. Parmenides object-directed Cognition and PSR stable reasons do not supply this propositional knowledge relation.
